_comment: Pinned build inputs, fetched into third_party/ as plain git clones by scripts/fetch_sources.sh. NOT submodules by design: SwiftPM recursively initializes submodules of git dependencies, which would make every consumer clone the full Skia + HarfBuzz history (~1.1 GB) for a ~23 MB binary product.

skia.note: m157 (SkMilestone.h). Branch termkit/m157 of the project's own fork: upstream chrome/m157 at 174579d7 plus the 29 rust-skia commits of tag m157.2, so the same build serves rust-skia 0.157.0 (ADR-0013 in term-kit)

harfbuzz.note: reports 14.5.1; the exact commit Skia m157's DEPS pins for its bundled HarfBuzz, so the pack's standalone HarfBuzz is the source rust-skia's own build would have compiled
